title: Jaku-Chara Tomozaki-kun OVA
justification: AniList 127363 (OVA, 2 episode(s) from 2021-05-07) is AniDB 15144's special(s) S1-S2, aired 2021-05-07 and 2021-06-02. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 112443, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 15144, and each special's title matches an AniList synonym (Post-game equipment for girls is a little different than usual; Most strange spell names have unknown origins). TVDB 388737 0x1-0x2 agree on title and date.
